ns2:section.sectionText: Students must register for the online portion and one lab section. Please note the stated prerequisites. The registration system will allow you to select this course even if you do not meet the prerequisites. You will be dropped from the course when pre-reqs are checked.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or News-Editorial major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
